originality.rationale: Composition-idempotent endomorphisms are separated from the complete hom-set already classified in arXiv:2610.02393v1. The new claim is an exact retraction image-size polynomial and a closed factorized count, proved using cyclic-unit group and valuation strata. The primary 2026 paper discusses hom-sets and pointwise products, but no composition-idempotent image enumerator was identified in the inspected sections and full-text search. published-finding corpus and literature comparisons found no equivalent or strictly stronger result. Priority is qualified by the inaccessible 2026 doctoral thesis and potentially different retraction terminology.
